Author: Allan Wick
Message:
feat(ci): secret-material lint for non-secret fields (ADR-0001 Pillar 3, WIC-879) (#62)

Fails CI when secret-shaped material (API keys, tokens, PEM private keys)
appears in a committed non-secret field — binding names, resource names,
labels, or any tracked file. Cheap insurance against a repeat of WIC-751,
where an Anthropic key leaked as a Worker binding name.

- Pure, unit-tested core: packages/api/src/lib/secret-scan.ts
- File-discovery CLI (git ls-files): packages/api/src/secret-scan.ts
- Prefix/shape patterns: ghp_, github_pat_, sk-ant-, AIza, AWS, Slack,
  Twilio, Cloudflare, PEM private keys; realistic-length suffix so
  placeholders (sk-ant-..., ghp_xxx) don't trip.
- Conservative high-entropy heuristic on config/manifest files only
  (ignores ids/SHAs/URLs) to keep false positives low.
- Findings point at file:line:col + offending field; redacted output —
  never echoes the raw secret.
- Allowlist: inline `secret-scan:allow` pragma or
  .github/secret-scan-allowlist.json.
- Wired into deploy.yml lint-and-test job; npm run scan:secrets.
- Docs: docs/architecture/secret-scan.md. 14 unit tests + fixtures
  (catches sk-ant- in a binding name; passes a clean config).

* fix(api): fix cover letter truncation and align word targets with UI (WIC-131)

max_tokens was 1024 which caused mid-sentence cutoff when the AI
overshoot the word target. Raise to 2048 (covers up to ~1300 words with
headroom). Also sync WORD_TARGETS with the UI range labels:
  concise: 250-350 (was 150-250)
  standard: 400-550 (was 300-400)
  detailed: 600-800 (was 450-550)

Co-Authored-By: Paperclip <noreply@paperclip.ing>

* fix(api): fix cover letter mid-sentence cutoff via prompt + stop_reason (WIC-131)

The length instruction "Length: N-M words" was being interpreted as a
hard stop, causing the model to truncate mid-sentence at the upper
bound. Replace with a target-range instruction that explicitly tells
the model to always complete the letter naturally.

Also add stop_reason === 'max_tokens' detection so any future
truncation surfaces as a CONTENT_TRUNCATED warning in the response
rather than silently delivering incomplete output.

Applied to both generate and revise prompts.

Co-Authored-By: Paperclip <noreply@paperclip.ing>

* fix(api): always return JSON from cover letter export endpoint (WIC-131)

Route was content-negotiating on Accept header — when Accept:
application/json was absent (API client only sends Content-Type),
it returned raw binary DOCX. The client then tried to JSON-parse
the PK-prefixed DOCX bytes and threw "Unexpected token 'P'".

POST /cover-letters/:id/export is only ever called by the browser
client which always wants base64 JSON to construct a Blob download.
Remove the content negotiation and always return the JSON response.

Co-Authored-By: Paperclip <noreply@paperclip.ing>

* fix(test): update export test to match always-JSON behavior (WIC-142)

Commit d63d7d3 changed the export endpoint to always return JSON with
base64Content. The test 'returns binary docx when no Accept header' was
never updated and continued asserting the old binary response behavior.

Updated test name and assertions to match current intended behavior.
